title: Court Mein Hisaab
hook_reason: We land mid-trial: Neha is already in judge mode and reading out Rohan's pending 800 rupees, so the tension is there from the first second.
plan: s01 6 words = 4 s; s02 4 words = 4 s; s03 silent = 4 s; s04 5 words = 4 s; s05 9 words = 6 s; total 22 s

shots.framing: Neha centered on the sofa, navy dupatta over her shoulder, steel tumbler raised in one hand, phone held in the other hand at chest height
shots.speaker: neha
shots.first_frame: Neha sits upright on the faded teal sofa with the navy dupatta over one shoulder, a steel tumbler in her right hand like a gavel and her phone in her left hand, her face mock-serious.

beats.action: Taps the steel tumbler twice on the table edge and then points it toward the off-screen accused

shots.setting: faded teal sofa, low center table with chai cups, beige wall behind

shots.delivery: theatrical and deliberate, dry judge voice, a small pause after the second order

shots.speaker: rohan
shots.first_frame: Rohan sits barefoot on the sofa in the mustard t-shirt, a cushion in his lap, his hands open at his sides, his face wide-eyed and pretending to be innocent.

beats.action: Spreads both hands out palms up and shrugs his shoulders

shots.setting: sofa end, drying rack with clothes in the corner, beige wall
shots.lighting: low evening sun through the living room window, warm yellow table lamp as fill

shots.setting: phone in hand, steel tumbler and chai cups blurred on the center table
shots.lighting: low evening sun through the living room window, warm yellow table lamp as fill

beats.action: Taps his phone screen once with his thumb, then lowers the phone to his lap
